articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: J & J SNACK FOODS SCHEDULES FISCAL 2026 SECOND QUARTER EARNINGS CONFERENCE CALL AND WEBCAST. MOUNT LAUREL, N.J., April 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- J & J Snack Foods Corp. (Nasdaq: JJSF) today announced that it will release financial results for its fiscal second quarter ended March 28, 2026, before the stock market opens on Wednesday, May 6, 2026. The Company will hold a conference call and webcast to discuss the results at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time that same day.
